name: @speed/auth-core
description: Speed auth core: the browser session lifecycle (the login flow's start/answer/current/abandon, the link, step-up and enroll flows, logout and silent refresh) as a memory-only state machine over the generated authn surface of @speed/api-sdk, with the in-memory access-token store as the bridge into @speed/api-client, hand-written response models with runtime guards, plus React hooks (useAuthState, useCurrentTenant, usePermission) reading one host-attached session and the tenant-scoped query-key convention
